WITH status_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval AS status,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS gb_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
rate_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) AS average_rate
  FROM status_totals
)
SELECT
  st.status,
  st.total_scan_count,
  st.gb_per_minute_rate,
  st.gb_per_minute_rate - ra.average_rate AS rate_minus_average
FROM status_totals AS st
CROSS JOIN rate_average AS ra
WHERE st.gb_per_minute_rate > ra.average_rate;
